description: Réglementation de la circulation et du stationnement 2016 à Bordeaux is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Bordeaux. Liste des éléments de circulation et de stationnement réglementés par arrêté municipal. Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal files it under Transports/mobilité. Its keywords are Arrêtés, Circulation, Réglementation, Stationnement, Voie publique. The portal shows 10,041 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2019-04-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
